name: qsm_ineq3_0

    a ^ 2 / b + b ^ 2 / c + c ^ 2 / a ≥ a + b + c := by

name: qsm_fib_identity_0
formal_statement:
theorem qsm_fib_identity_0 (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, Nat.fib i + 1 = Nat.fib (n + 1) := by

name: qsm_fib_identity_1
formal_statement:
theorem qsm_fib_identity_1 (n : ℕ) :
    Nat.fib (2 * n + 1) = Nat.fib n ^ 2 + Nat.fib (n + 1) ^ 2 := by

name: qsm_fib_identity_2
formal_statement:
theorem qsm_fib_identity_2 (n : ℕ) :
    (Nat.fib (n + 2) : ℤ) * Nat.fib n - (Nat.fib (n + 1) : ℤ) ^ 2 = (-1) ^ (n + 1) := by
